artworks.title: Jurors Listening to Counsel, Supreme Court, New City Hall, New York
artworks.description: The image shows a courtroom scene with individuals in the jury box and a person standing facing them. The standing man is holding a piece of paper and gesturing with his left hand. He has dark hair, a mustache, and wears a formal suit. The jurors, mostly men, have different hairstyles, with one man being bald. They appear attentive, with some resting their chins on their hands or leaning forward. They wear dark suits and high-collared shirts. A tall man in the background observes the proceedings. The setting is a wood-paneled courtroom with a judge sitting at a high bench. Light comes in through a window, illuminating part of the room. Items like a top hat are on the jury's bench. The atmosphere suggests focus and authority.

artworks.title: Raid on a Sand-Swallow Colony - "How Many Eggs?"
artworks.description: This drawing features a sandy cliff with birds flying around. The scene depicts a sandy embankment and various birds in flight around the cliff face. The ground is textured with markings, and grasses and foliage are present. Shadow work suggests a three-dimensional quality to the earth.

artworks.title: Art-Students and Copyists in the Louvre Gallery, Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art gallery where artists are working on their paintings. The scene is set in a spacious gallery with high arched ceilings and walls lined with artwork. Multiple artists are depicted actively engaged in painting and sketching, each stationed in their own area with easels and canvases. The drawing captures the busy atmosphere of the gallery, showcasing artists in different postures of concentration and creation. The setting is detailed with architectural features like columns and the ceiling, adding context to the environment. The foreground and background show activity, with figures observing or interacting with the artworks around them. The drawing follows detailed line work and shading to create a sense of realism and perspective in the space.

artworks.title: The Army of the Potomac - A Sharp-Shooter on Picket Duty
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure aiming a rifle from a tree. The composition shows a figure in military uniform sitting on a tree branch, intently aiming a long rifle towards the right side of the image. The person is perched comfortably yet alertly, with one leg crossed over the other and the weight distributed on the branch. The background is filled with finely detailed pine branches and trees. To the right, a round canteen is hanging from a branch. The intricate lines and shading capture the textures of the fabric and foliage, rendering a detailed scene typical of illustrations from the period of the Civil War.

artworks.title: Sea-Side Sketches - A Clam-Bake
artworks.artist: William H. Redding after Winslow Homer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of children at the seaside preparing for a clambake. The scene is set on a rocky beach where several young boys are depicted engaged in various activities. Two boys in the foreground are carrying a large pail together. In the center, another boy is resting against a large rock. A group of boys is gathered behind the rock, appearing to be stoking a fire, as smoke rises into the sky. In the background, there is a calm sea with sailboats on the horizon beneath a partly cloudy sky. The drawing captures a moment at the shoreline emphasizing teamwork and camaraderie among the children.

artworks.title: A Snow Slide in the City
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene in a city street where snow has fallen from a rooftop onto the street below. Various people are depicted in mid-action as they react to the event. The individuals are dressed in historical clothing, with some wearing long coats, dresses, and hats. In the background, structures like a shopfront and lampposts are visible. The art style is illustrative and detailed, focusing on the reactions and poses of the figures as they engage in avoiding or being caught by the falling snow. The illustration effectively conveys surprise and movement, with elements such as people slipping, articles of clothing being dislodged, and snow bursting into the air contributing to the energetic atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Parisian Ball - Dancing at the Mabille, Paris
artworks.description: In this black and white illustration, several figures are depicted dancing energetically. Positioned in the center, both men and women are engaged in a lively dance. The men are wearing formal attire, including top hats and suits with tails. The women wear long, flowing dresses with full skirts, featuring stripes and patterns. Some women are holding their skirts up. The background is filled with a large crowd of other spectators also dressed in formal wear, under a canopy of hanging lights. Stone arches in the far background suggest the scene takes place in a grand hall or garden pavilion.

artworks.title: The Battle of Bunker-Hill - Watching the Fight from Copp's Hill, in Boston
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several individuals on a rooftop overlooking a bay. In the background, several ships and a distant hill are visible. The rooftop is crowded with people, some elevated. The sky is filled with thick clouds. Rooftops and a chimney are detailed. The perspective shows further rooftops with people and a distant ship in the water. A church steeple can be seen on the far horizon.

artworks.title: Christmas Belles
artworks.description: An illustration showing several people seated in a sleigh, drawn by horses, outside in a wintry setting. Six people occupy the sleigh. In the front left, a man is holding the reins, wearing a dark coat and hat. To his right, four women sit, adorned in winter clothing with fur trim, dark coats, and decorative hats with feathers. The women have youthful facial features, with long hair styled beneath their hats. One of the women in the back holds a fan-like object. The sleigh is ornate, with detailed decorations on the sides, and lined fur acting as warmth. Horses, visible with bridles and reigns, are pulling the sleigh through a snowy landscape with bare trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Fire-Works on the Night of the Fourth of July
artworks.description: The image shows a large crowd of people depicted from the shoulders up, closely packed together and facing forward. Many are looking slightly upward. The expressions on their faces vary from awe to surprise. Both men and women are present, with the men often wearing hats. The women often have their hair styled or covered by small hats or bonnets. Many individuals have mustaches or beards, and their clothing is formal for the period, including suits, dresses, and shawls. Some people are holding objects like canes or parasols. The background features a dense crowd and a dark night sky with fireworks visible in the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: The Songs of War
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white illustration featuring soldiers in various scenes associated with war. Musical notations and collections of lyrics such as "The bold soldier boy," "The girl I left behind me," and "Dixie" are depicted alongside the scenes. The soldiers are shown marching, a mounted officer is on horseback, and others are seen in camp. At the bottom, a group of soldiers marches with large lettering that reads "Glory Hallelujah." The composition includes bugles, flags, and musical staffs.

artworks.title: Skating on the Ladies' Skating-Pond in the Central Park, New York
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing a scene on an ice rink. The view is slightly elevated, with a blurred hill in the upper third where people are watching. A group of well-dressed individuals, including men, women, and children, are skating on the ice. More people are skating in the background, with spectators and trees in the distance. The illustration uses fine lines and shading for texture and depth, capturing the skaters' movement and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray for contrast and emphasizing the figures' motion on the ice.

artworks.title: Thanksgiving Day, 1860 - The Two Great Classes of Society
artworks.description: This is a drawing portraying "The Two Great Classes" of society during Thanksgiving Day in 1860. The full-description shows two contrasting scenes in one illustration, divided into sections. The top section portrays individuals lounging leisurely in opulent surroundings, while the bottom section reflects individuals in a humble setting, showcasing scenes of poverty and need. The drawing is framed with decorative borders and contains vignettes of both luxurious and sparse domestic environments, commenting on the social divide of the era.

artworks.title: Thanksgiving Day - Ways and Means [upper left]
artworks.description: The image shows four panels depicting different scenes related to Thanksgiving Day celebrations. The upper left panel shows a farm scene with turkeys, a man unloading sacks, and snow-covered ground. The upper right panel shows a dining room full of people around a large table enjoying a meal. The lower left panel depicts a scene titled "Thanksgiving Day—Arrival at the Old Home" with a carriage in front of a house. The lower right panel, titled "Thanksgiving Day—The Dance", shows a cozy indoor setting with people dancing and socializing.

artworks.title: The War for the Union, 1862 - A Bayonet Charge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military battle scene. The image shows a bayonet charge during a historical war. Numerous soldiers in 19th-century military uniforms are engaged in close combat, wielding rifles with fixed bayonets. The scene is chaotic, with soldiers advancing through a grassy battlefield amidst lingering gunfire smoke. The background shows a line of soldiers in a more organized formation and hints of trees. The illustration captures the tumult and fervor of a heated confrontation with detailed linework and shading, adding to the historical and dynamic feel of the artwork.

artworks.title: The Great Russian Ball at the Academy of Music, November 5, 1863
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom with dancers. The scene depicts couples dancing in a grand ballroom with a sizeable audience. The architecture is detailed, with ornate designs on the walls and ceilings, and a large chandelier. The women wear elegant gowns and the men are in formal wear. The drawing conveys movement and festivity, with a lively atmosphere of celebration in a high society setting.

artworks.title: Campaign Sketches: The Letter for Home
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting beside a man in bed. The woman has sculptured facial features and is sitting upright with her body turned towards the man. She is wearing a dark-colored gown with a hooded cloak and has a scarf loosely wrapped around her head. She is holding an open book or document. The man is lying on his side with his eyes closed, resting on a pillow. He has short hair and a beard, wearing a light shirt. There is a cup on a table beside the bed. The room has large windows, multiple beds, and other figures present.

artworks.title: Campaign Sketches: Our Jolly Cook
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dynamic pose, holding an object in his hands. He is surrounded by other men who appear to be soldiers, some seated and others standing. The background includes tents and soldiers observing the scene. Smoke is visible near the ground.

artworks.title: The Ass at School
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.6 x 30.4 cm (9 5/16 x 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This print shows a chaotic classroom scene, with young students engaging in various activities, some appearing mischievous and inattentive. In the top left corner, a donkey stands on its back feet behind a desk, one of its front hooves resting on the surface next to a page of sheet music. Also on the desk is a lit candle and what appears to be a pair of glasses. In the center of the print, an adult figure in a long dress with a feathered hat is in the middle of a group of small figures. Some of the students hold sheets of paper or large books, while others interact with one another, making strange expressions, or sit in various buckets and baskets. Other objects fill the space, like low benches, vases, and discarded books. In the background, a tall figure appears to be standing in an enclosed space with a barred window.

artworks.title: La Ferme aux peupliers de Hollande
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with trees, a cottage, and a farmhouse. The viewpoint is from the ground, looking across the tree-filled scene. The trees have leaning trunks and branches reaching upwards. The horizon is low, emphasizing the trees. The line work of the etching is intricate and fluid, capturing the movement of branches and landscape texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background. The tree forms closest to us are prominent, leading the eye along the trunks. The sunlight filters through the leaves. Buildings are seen in the distance among the trees.

artworks.title: Ath. L. Charles Coquerel
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish figure standing upright. The person has their hands clasped together in front of their body. They have exaggerated facial features, including a large forehead, prominent eyebrows, sideburns, and round glasses. The figure has short, dark hair and is wearing a formal suit with a dark jacket, white shirt or cravat, and dark trousers. The illustration uses shading to show depth and texture in the clothing. The background is a simple, shaded area with no additional objects or details.

artworks.title: Ath. L. Charles Coquerel
artworks.description: The image is a caricature of a man standing with his hands clasped in front of him. He has a large forehead, exaggerated facial features, round spectacles, dark shoulder-length hair with sideburns, and is wearing a dark suit. The background is simple with sketchy lines and small dots.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Allegorical Composition (Composition allegorique)
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin and Charles Francois Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing confidently with one arm resting on a tall tool or staff, the other hand on their hip. The person has distinct facial features and styled hair with a feathered ornament. They wear a skirt-like garment made of feathers. Various objects are around them, including a cylindrical item and a container on the ground. In the background are skies, a tree, hills, and seated figures. The scene is rendered in a detailed, monochromatic sketch style.

artworks.title: Heroic Act of a Father Who Sacrifices for His Son (Trait heroique d'un pere qui se sacrifie pour son fils)
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin and Charles Francois Le Tellier
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures under a large tree. Some figures appear distressed, while others seem to be in motion. The composition is packed with activity and some figures are partly or fully unclothed. The intricate tree serves as a backdrop. The artwork has detailed line work and shading, creating depth and emotion. There is text at the bottom that adds a poetic touch, hinting at themes of sacrifice and protection.
